title: Operational evidence-queue handoff
objective: Materialize the valuation priority queue as an explicit collector artifact and make its handoff fail-closed.

steps.title: Persist top-100 priority tasks under collector ops
Attach product and format identity to queue
Report queue artifact from valuation generator
Point collector policy at materialized queue
Fail closed when queue artifact is missing
Fail closed when priority queue is stale
Require exact task IDs during queue consumption

guarantees: Queue generation does not promote any valuation.
Collector priority consumption requires exact task identity.
A missing or stale priority artifact cannot silently alter priority scheduling.
